schema.label: Which way the screen turns
schema.description: How the digitizer is mounted. Standard is right for this model. If the two portrait positions come out mirrored pick Upright, if the two flat ones do pick Flat, and if everything is upside down pick 180. Anything but Standard means the mount matrix in docs/hardware.md wants correcting.
